source.name: FC Dallas – 'FC Dallas Unveils New "DNA Kit" Ahead of 2026 Season'
source.quote: Children’s Health is the front-of-jersey partner. UT Southwestern Medical Center remains the front-of-jersey partner for the Inferno Kit.

source.name: FC Dallas – 'FC Dallas Unveils New "DNA Kit" Ahead of 2026 Season'
source.quote: Returning for 2026, the Apple TV sleeve patch appears on the left sleeve of both FC Dallas jerseys.

summary: Red hoops DNA kit, new for 2026-27. Children's Health on the front and the Apple TV league patch on the left sleeve; the club's launch announcement names no other sponsor placement on the kit, and no right-sleeve sponsor.
